messages:
eli: Quick heads-up  found a leaked API key in the sample-app README. Someone pasted a real-looking sk- token into the Python snippet and it got copied into a public repo. Filed SUP-4410.

rachel: ugh, which doc?

eli: docs/quickstart/python.md. snippet shows:

```eli: import os
import requests
API_KEY = \"sk-12345ABCDE\"  # DO NOT DO THIS
resp = requests.post(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat\", headers={\"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {API_KEY}\"}, json={\"input\":\"hi\"})
print(resp.json())
```

luis: ouch. besides the literal key, the example doesn't set a timeout or explain retries. people copy/paste that into scripts and then blow up when theres a transient 5xx.

rachel: Agreed. Fix plan: replace literal with os.environ usage, show a safe requests pattern (timeout + no hardcoded token), and add a paragraph that recommends using the SDK for production (it provides connection pooling and automatic retries for 429/5xx).

ci-bot: Proposed CI rule: docs pipeline fails if regex \"sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}\" or \"REPLACE_ME_?WITH\" appears in committed docs. Quick grep in CI should catch this.

eli: Also add a tiny example showing how to make raw HTTP safer:

```eli: import os
import requests
API_KEY = os.environ.get(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\")
resp = requests.post(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat\", headers={\"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {API_KEY}\"}, json={\"input\":\"hi\"}, timeout=10)
resp.raise_for_status()
```

luis: And show an SDK snippet and how to turn off retries/pooling for one-off scripts:

```eli: from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], pool_connections=1, retries=0)  # disable pooling/retries for single-shot use
res = client.chat.create(input='hi')
```

rachel: Opening PR now. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/653 - title: \"quickstart/python: remove hardcoded key, add env var/timeouts, CI check\"

docs-bot: New PR opened by rachel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/653 — title: \"quickstart/python: remove hardcoded key, add env var/timeouts, CI check\"

luis: I'll take the review and add the md-lint CI rule + the grep.

rachel: Thanks. After merge we need to notify security/support to rotate the leaked key and add a short note to the docs author checklist: never paste tokens in examples. :pray:
